pinout.notes: I2C-programmable PLL clock generator, 3x outputs. Pinout per datasheet.

typical_applications: Programmable clock source for misc board clocks
verification_notes: Family, package, supply verified. The chip is I2C-programmed and the configuration is board-specific; the engine cannot verify an arbitrary programmed config.
replacement_notes: Si5351A/B/C differ in output count and feature set. A blank replacement needs reprogramming via I2C with the board's config (typically stored in an EEPROM).
